articles.title: Welcome!
Research
articles.description: My research focuses on the impact of knowledge flows and local capabilities on innovation, technology adoption, and development. The theoretical framework from which I approach these phenomena considers the social interactions that characterise the economy as a complex system. From this perspective, it is understood that the system evolves partially conditioned by its past and the territory in which economic activities occur. My main papers have been published in:

articles.title: Teaching
articles.description: My teaching experience has been developed at undergraduate and postgraduate levels in courses on social network analysis applied to economics, labour economics, economic development, research methodology in economics and data analysis using [*R*](<https://www.r-project.org/>){target="_blank"}.
